# NimoteCode

> NimoteCode is a Mobile AI Development Workspace available for Android and iOS. It combines SSH workspaces, split code editing, in-app web and media preview, terminals, Git workflows, AI Chat and Agent, debugging, tasks, sync/cache, and product support in one app.

NimoteCode is organized around a few primary journeys: learn the product, compare Free and Pro, install the app, and move into the documentation for day-to-day workflows.

The product is positioned as a Mobile AI Development Workspace: Editor + Explorer + SSH + Web Preview + Terminal + Git + AI Chat and Agent. It is not only an SSH client or a standalone code editor.

- [Mobile IDE](https://nimotecode.com/mobile-ide): Mobile IDE overview for SSH, Git, and AI coding.
- [SSH IDE](https://nimotecode.com/ssh-ide): Remote development workflow for SSH projects.
- [Mobile AI Coding](https://nimotecode.com/mobile-ai-coding): AI Chat and Agent alongside editor, terminal, and Git context.
- [Demo](https://nimotecode.com/demo): Product video and written workflow walkthrough.

## Guides
- [Mobile Developer Lab](https://nimotecode.com/blog/): Practical mobile development tutorials.
- [How to Use Android as a Remote IDE with Tailscale and NimoteCode: Free SSH Access to Mac and Linux](https://nimotecode.com/blog/tailscale-ssh-android-mac-linux): A guide to free private SSH access over the internet, without a public IP address or router port forwarding.
